description: Task Engine lifecycle event type 'workerBlacklisted'. Published when a worker is blacklisted on a queue after crossing the consecutive-failure threshold (PRD cpt-cf-task-engine-fr-worker-blacklist). Subject is the queue the worker is blacklisted on (subject_type gts.cf.core.tasks.queue.v1~); the worker identity (`subject_id`, `worker_id`) is carried in data.worker_subject and data.worker. Derived from the Event Broker base event type; routed to the task_events topic and partitioned by subject (the queue ID) for per-queue ordering.

type.$comment: Pins the event-type identifier so an editor can validate a payload against this schema alone.

worker.description: Blacklisted worker (`worker_id`). Worker ID sent by the worker on claim (PRD §5.6 Worker identity). Together with the subject field it forms the worker identity.

queue.description: Queue the worker is blacklisted on (also the event subject).

failure_count.description: Consecutive failures that triggered the blacklisting.
